nodes.label: Sascar Platform Adapter
nodes.rationale: Bookmarklet is used instead of automatic login because the Sascar portal requires server-side CAPTCHA, making login automation unfeasible.

nodes.label: Postgres RPC and Daily Rollup for Analytics
nodes.rationale: RPC and rollup are used to speed up analytics queries by performing normalizations on write and reading from a daily rollup, preventing CPU exhaustion on the micro burstable Supabase instance.

nodes.label: TipTap Editor Integration
nodes.rationale: TipTap is used to replace native contentEditable because contentEditable loses the cursor position when React re-renders, while TipTap keeps the state internally and avoids cursor jumps.

nodes.label: MedNet Platform Visual Branding
nodes.rationale: The visual branding combines a bold, white system-ui sans-serif 'M' letter (representing MedNet) with an orange medical cross/plus sign (#F26931) in the top-right corner, placed against a premium dark red/burgundy gradient background (#9E1A45 to #5A0F25) with a 7px border radius.

nodes.label: MedNet Brand Identity
nodes.rationale: The logo features a clean white sans-serif letter 'M' paired with an orange '+' medical/healthcare cross symbol on a premium dark maroon gradient rounded background. It is designed as a maskable PWA icon to support visual branding across various operating systems.

nodes.label: MedNet Brand Identity (192x192)
nodes.rationale: The logo features a clean white sans-serif letter 'M' paired with an orange '+' medical/healthcare cross symbol on a premium dark maroon rounded background. It serves as the standard 192x192 PWA application launcher icon.

nodes.label: MedNet Brand Identity
nodes.rationale: The logo features a white letter 'M' with an orange medical cross or plus sign at the top-right corner, set against a dark red/burgundy rounded square background. This design combines the initial 'M' for MedNet with the plus symbol representing health, using modern non-generic colors (burgundy/orange) to create a premium medical application brand identity.
